channel.title: Daily brief - Martin Jordanovski
channel.description: AI, technology and software development news, summarised every morning. Leadership, psychology and investing on Mondays.

item.title: Daily brief, 25 Nov 2026
item.description:
Tidal bans fully AI-generated music from December 9: Tidal will ban fully AI-generated music on December 9 and delete about 29 million such songs. It expects to reject roughly 80,000 to 85,000 tracks a day, while still accepting music made with AI assistance.
Active intrusion campaign targets Check Point security management servers: An active intrusion campaign against Check Point security management servers is drawing significant attention on Hacker News. The available item gives no further technical detail.
Microsoft declares internal 'Code Red' after near-24-hour Outlook and Exchange Online outage: A nearly 24-hour Exchange Online and Outlook outage left email down for millions of customers. Reuters reports Microsoft declared an unusual internal 'Code Red' after a bug on its Microsoft 365 networking gateway servers triggered the failure.
